summary: AI engineer with four years building and shipping production LLM systems end-to-end: agentic workflows, RAG and retrieval, prompt engineering, and LLM output evaluation and guardrails. I work to a production-quality bar with strong Python, code review, and debugging discipline, and I've evaluated and hardened AI-generated output and model responses for reliability. Available for fully remote contract work.

bullets: Designed the retrieval, prompt, and output-guardrail layers for a production medical chatbot, evaluating model output for correctness and reliability and reducing hallucination risk.
Built an LLM-powered clinical decision-support agent that retrieves patient history to generate medication recommendations and AI-assisted diagnostic guidance.
Owned the full AI feature lifecycle: architecture, retrieval and prompt design, output validation, deployment, and monitoring across production systems.
Built the retrieval and data layer (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis); caching and optimized queries improved data-access performance by **30%** for high-frequency inference calls.
Built an AI-driven wellness platform with LangChain and RAG pipelines, normalizing third-party health data and retrieving relevant context to generate personalized plans.
Developed an AI Virtual Trainer agent with agentic reasoning and personalization, increasing user engagement by **40%**; owned design, development, and deployment.
Engineered a GPT-Canvas-style streaming LLM renderer using token streaming and incremental rendering, achieving **98%** rendering accuracy.
Built SmartMedHx, an AI-assisted patient-intake system applying LLM extraction to turn unstructured clinical data into structured records.
Built Refill Arena from zero to **$1M+ revenue**, owning backend infrastructure, data models, and scalable APIs across **3,200+ brands** and **190+ countries**.
Improved backend performance by **25%** through query optimization and caching; delivered features from requirements to deployment with remote stakeholders.
